answer: Under EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, an identity’s score reflects its contribution to normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust paths, not a self-asserted balance. Exponential temporal decay with a half-life discounts stale endorsements, so durable centrality requires sustained honest service. A freshly spawned sybil starts near zero and lacks trusted paths to pass consensus; even a mesa of umber accounts cannot quickly bootstrap one another, while lantern-like reciprocal links add little without established external trust.
